title: Trade log
dek: The Heavy Reading trade book: the ledger, the discussion log, settlement marks, the scoreboard, and the feedback loop.

claims.text: Trade book opened October 12, 2026 with five trades and re-booked the same day to the trade-ideas strip form: trade 1 active (short December TMW), the TMR strip active at starter pace (trade 2, with trade 4's switching mechanism folded in as participation), trade 3's synthetic crude rides sequenced behind trade 1's exit, and trade 5 stood down (TMW-TMS reversion, shadow-marked at 36 lots per side).

Open risk after the re-booking: about $481,000, about 1.9R (1R = $250,000), inside the 2R complex budget; sequenced to about $496,000, about 2.0R, when trade 1 exits. The booking-day overage (about $577,000, about 2.3R) was resolved by the strip-form rethink, not by either option first printed; the resolution is booked in the log.
All booked trades mark flat at inception levels: entry references are the October 9, 2026 ICE settles and the October 12, 2026 settlements file carries the same settles at zero volume.
